justification: _JUNK_REF auto-rejected every ref starting 'table'; the AI reader copies printed table numbers, so 'Table 6.1' (CoS s6) and numbered signage tables were auto-rejected and blocked commits. Now only a bare 'table' (no number) is junk.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: numbered tables are rejected or bare junk refs pass
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Restoring the old '^table' alternative fails the new test; restored fix, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/dcp_extract_changed.py: the 12 CoS s6 table rows it rejected were approved by hand and are live (2026-10-19)

pre_impl.existing_data: held chapters' review rows lack the intro/scope sentences printed on the PDF pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: page coverage judges a page by most of its rule lines, so an intro paragraph can be lost on a passed page
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the reader after _reread_skipped_pages; reuses page_coverage.running_lines and doubled_text

functions.name: classify_row_fidelity
functions.input: one queue row's ref, old text, new text and change type
functions.output: ok or failed with reasons; junk_ref no longer fires on numbered tables

break_it.scenario: a long numbered table title with an en dash
